responsibility: Implements expression-path resolution during lowering, turning resolved HIR paths into backend references or values. It handles constants, locals, closure captures, pattern bindings, unit structs and enum discriminant constructors, already-compiled functions, intrinsic functions, and on-demand query compilation of ordinary items, extern items, impl items, and trait items; it also contains the shared query_compile logic that decides which compilation path to force based on resolver and type-check results.
same_name_distinction: Implements path-expression resolution and the shared query_compile fallback logic. Unlike rust-compile-resolve-path.h, it contains the decision-making that turns resolved paths into constants, locals, pattern bindings, function addresses, unit/enum constructor values, or on-demand compilation of items, extern items, impl items, and trait items.
